name: BepInEx 6 plugin (IL2CPP)
summary: A plugin dll for Unity IL2CPP games (the ones with GameAssembly.dll), loaded by the BepInEx 6 bleeding edge builds. The usual choice for Among Us.
description: A net6.0 class library that BepInEx 6 loads from BepInEx\plugins. Pick the game and the project references the interop assemblies BepInEx generated for it in BepInEx\interop and copies the built dll into the game after every build.

options.help: The BepInEx.Unity.IL2CPP package to compile against. The default takes the newest bleeding edge build.

options.help: Settings saved to BepInEx\config that players can edit.

Only load in this game's exe

next: Open the folder in Visual Studio, Rider or VS Code.
Start the game once with BepInEx 6 installed so BepInEx\interop gets generated, then build: dotnet build -c Release
The dll is in bin\Release\net6.0. With a game folder set it is also copied to BepInEx\plugins in the game.
Start the game and look for the plugin's line in BepInEx\LogOutput.log.
Your code starts in Plugin.cs, in Load.
